name: pnp-powerplatform-prompts-document-approval-with-escalation
title: Document Approval with Escalation
shortDescription: Power Automate workflow that routes new SharePoint documents to reviewers, escalates to managers after 48 hours, and posts the final decision to Teams.
longDescription: This Power Automate prompt creates a multi-stage document approval flow: triggered on new SharePoint file uploads, it looks up the reviewer from a mapping list, sends an approval request, waits 48 hours, escalates to the department manager if unresponded, then updates the SharePoint status column and posts the outcome to a Teams channel. Demonstrates the timeout-and-escalate pattern.

metadata.value: Build a workflow that monitors a SharePoint document library, routes to a reviewer, escalates after 48 hours, and posts the decision to Teams.
